report.verdict: A senior platform engineer with strong reliability work and a partial match for money movement.
write_up: Your resume is strong: you connect platform work at Tidewater Commerce to numbers a recruiter can use, from service migrations to faster builds! I read it for Senior Software Engineer. The Cobalt Pay role also fits parts of your background, especially Go and payment reliability, though some of its money-movement requirements aren't shown.

The CI templates are a great model: you name what you built, the tool, and the change in build time. Your payment failover work is just as compelling, but it sits below office activities in the Tidewater role.

Let's put the payment and reliability work first for Cobalt Pay, then add the migration team detail and what maintaining the PHP panel involved. Your resume has plenty of substantive engineering work; the match for this particular role will also depend on the experience you can show with its specific requirements.

cards.line: Migrated 60 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on EKS over nine months with no customer-facing downtime
cards.cannot_tell: The migration and its result are clear. For a senior role, a recruiter will also want to know how many engineers worked on it.
cards.example: Migrated 60 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on EKS over nine months with no customer-facing downtime, working with [number] engineers
cards.question: How many other engineers worked on the migration?

cards.line: Maintained the legacy PHP admin panel until it was retired in 2022
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see which system you maintained, but not what that work involved. One concrete example would give the PHP work more substance.
cards.example: Maintained the legacy PHP admin panel until it was retired in 2022, including [maintenance work]
cards.question: What maintenance work did you do on the admin panel?

cards.line: Wrote the CI pipeline templates in GitHub Actions that cut median build time from 14 minutes to 6
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It makes your contribution unmistakable and gives the reader a before and after.

cards.line: Built the internal developer portal in React and TypeScript that 140 engineers use to scaffold services
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above senior engineer, a technical decision that shaped other teams or systems would show more of your direction-setting work.
cards.example: Built the internal developer portal in React and TypeScript that 140 engineers use to scaffold services; [a technical decision you made] shaped [teams or systems]
cards.question: Did you make a technical decision on the portal that shaped other teams or systems, and what was it?

cards.line: Led the payment provider failover project with the payments team, cutting failed checkouts during provider outages from 3.1% to 0.4%
cards.cannot_tell: Move this above the office activities in the Tidewater role. It puts your payment reliability work where a recruiter will see it sooner.

fit.why: Your headline and current platform role point to senior software engineering, with Go services, migrations and payment reliability work.
fit.level: senior, leads a payment provider failover project and designs services
fit.note: Your checkout service, payment failover project and payment retries library are worth emphasizing for Cobalt Pay. Bring those forward and add any relevant work you can substantiate.
